role: Real second-pass code reviewer: statically scans real .ts files for TODO/FIXME markers, leftover console.log calls, and overly long functions — genuine checkable signals, not a fabricated LLM judgment call, same discipline as R-18's audit blind-spot scanner applied constructively.
behaviorDescription: reviewDirectory() reads every real .ts file in a directory and scans for three real, checkable signals: unfinished markers (TODO/FIXME/XXX), leftover console.log/console.debug calls, and functions over 60 lines (via the same brace-depth extraction technique as R-18). Verified against a real, already-clean file from tonight's build (zero false positives) and a synthetic fixture with planted issues (all three caught) before implementation. Read-only — never modifies any file.
hardStops: Never modifies any file on disk — strictly read-only static analysis
Never claims to replace real code-review judgment — flags concrete, checkable signals only
Never fabricates a finding not directly grounded in real file content
